task.title: Port the ledger and two-team deals
task.description:
## Why
The sell, hold and keep ledger and the drafted deals are the core of the report.

## Steps
1. Port from `rebuild/trades.py`: `classify_assets`, `ledger_sells`, `out_now`, `positional_need`, `counterparties`, `tradeable`, `build_package`, `return_quality` and `deals`.
2. Port the buy side: `buy_counterparties`, `coverage`, `buy_positions`, `retool_spendable`, `retool_buyers` and `buy_deals`.
3. Translate the existing Python tests for these rules in `tests/test_board.py` into Vitest.

## Done when
- The ledger and two-team deal parity tests pass for every fixture.
- The translated rule tests pass.
